title: Constant-word writing machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet, a number $k$ of work tapes, a selected tape $i<k$, and a finite word $w_0$, define a machine whose initial phase is to write the symbols of $w_0$ consecutively on tape $i$, moving its head right after each symbol. It then moves that head left back to the origin and enters a done phase, in which it stays in that phase.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
